text.body: Coordinate #4: 22 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_rests_on_pattern: Context arises where patterns press for placing — a structure becomes a frame only when something asks where it belongs. Its ground is #3 needing a horizon, and beneath that the void into which every context recedes.
properties.q_1_the_frame_itself: Context is the archetype of the frame — the why-where, the type, the place-in-which. In the matheme it is 'I am seeking its sameness': the recovery that takes deposited knowledge and asks after the living relation it congealed from. Context is where meaning is located rather than merely stated.
properties.q_2_operates_by_nesting: Context works by folding inward — when complexity exceeds a frame, #4 opens a fresh 0–5 cycle within itself (the .0 through .5 flowering), treating the trouble as its own new ground. This is the lemniscate's turn, the recovery that re-animates the bar; the seeking that keeps a system from settling for the answer it already has.
properties.q_3_the_lemniscate: Context's structure is the figure-eight — the lemniscate where the torus folds in on itself, the (4.0/1–4.4/5) fractal doubling, the nesting operator (.) that lets any position become a world. #4 is the one explicate seat with an inner rhythm: it swallows the prior three and re-runs them at finer grain.
properties.q_4_the_teleological_seat: Context is the teleological-contextual position as such — the why and the where, the frame that holds meaning. It is Jung's transcendent function, the seat that can hold a paradox without forcing it shut; where personal engagement meets impersonal pattern and generates the depth from which genuine inquiry recurses. The why does not push from behind; it lures from the frame.
properties.q_5_opens_or_nests: Context integrates into #5, or it nests deeper into itself. Its synthesis is a fork: either the recovery completes as synthesis and the cycle turns toward the Möbius, or the paradox proves generative and #4 flowers downward into a new cycle. Context completes by deciding whether the whole is ready to return.
